author: Nuon Bonong
changelog: Grade 12 volume 1 chapters 1-3 follow the 2023 science textbook: complex numbers (conjugate, vector picture, modulus, quotient, rotation, De Moivre in trigonometry), limits (irrational, composite and comparison, non-algebraic), continuity (properties, intervals, composite, continuous extension) and derivatives (inverse trig, higher order, motion, differential, economics); lesson titles carry textbook pages; chapter exams fixed.
